changes.summary: assertSameOrigin now compares complete origins and rejects malformed Origin values and same-host protocol/port mismatches.
Added regression coverage for configured origin, protocol/port mismatch, malformed origin and cross-site origin.
Added skip link and focusable main content anchor.
Added an accessible label to the primary navigation.
Added visible keyboard-only skip-link styling.
Restored scripts and dependencies inferred from the actual source tree.
Generated reproducible dependency lockfile with pnpm.
Restored strict Next.js TypeScript configuration and @ path alias.
Restored Next.js type references.
Restored Tailwind CSS v4 PostCSS integration.
Restored test alias and test discovery configuration.
Documented the intentional .mjs test import exception and typed the callback parameter.
Added SHA-256 manifest/file checks, detached signature verification, and HTTPS GitHub asset URL validation.
Added Release asset discovery, normalized digests, mandatory/security/minimum-version flags, and checksum/signature asset links.
Stable Release installation now requires a supported archive, size and SHA-256 verification, with optional detached signature enforcement.
Release workflow now runs only from main for branch pushes, emits update metadata and checksum assets, and can publish a detached signature from a CI secret.
Documented SOURCE/DOCKER/SIMULATE drivers, release asset requirements, signing configuration, and validation limits.
Added coverage for release asset discovery and mandatory/security/minimum-version metadata markers.
Added coverage for digest parsing, SHA-256 calculation, GitHub URL restrictions, and RSA detached signatures.
Confirmed the workspace has only local main plus origin/main; local main is 6 commits ahead and no remote push was performed.
Maintains the main-only local workflow: future updates are committed to main and temporary branches are removed after merge.
